title: Reversible valence states with irreversible crystal structures of NiFe layered double hydroxide catalysts: surface stability during the oxygen evolution reaction
content:

The surface of NiFe-LDH was revealed to be stable and did not change the initial valence states, Ni2+ and Fe3+, after a stable operation period.
